# Licensing and Self-Hosting Checklist: Self-hosted monospace font for code

**Purpose**: Validate that licence, attribution, reproducibility, privacy and visual-baseline requirements for the code font are complete, clear and consistent.
**Created**: 2026-10-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Licence and Attribution

- [x] CHK001 - Is the SIL OFL 1.1 requirement stated with what it permits (self-hosting, subsetting, commercial use) and the consequence of subsetting for the Reserved Font Name? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 - Is "committed unmodified with its copyright notice" defined, including where the licence file lives relative to the font files? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the requirement that the licence file is distinct from Inter's consistent with how feature 018 stored Inter's licence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK004 - Is it stated whether OFL attribution must also appear in a user-visible place (credits or colophon), or explicitly not required? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK005 - Is the fallback wording "or an equally permissive licence" bounded, now that the face is fixed as JetBrains Mono? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]

## Reproducible Subsets

- [x] CHK006 - Is the subset reproducible from a documented source (upstream version, source file origin, character set, tool and options)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 - Is the shipped character set defined once and shared with Inter, so both families cannot drift apart? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK008 - Are the requirements for the glyphs absent from the face (→ ✓ ✗ "where the face has those glyphs") specific about which are missing and how they fall back? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the character guard requirement defined with its failure output (character, code point, file) and a reasoned exclusion list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the scope of the guard (visual subjects only, not real content) consistent with the assumption that real content is ASCII? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the requirement that exactly four faces ship (no variable or extra-weight files) verifiable from the build output? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003]

## Self-Hosting and Privacy

- [x] CHK012 - Is "no request leaves the origin" defined across every page template, including stylesheets and preconnect hints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §SC-002]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the first-party mechanism for fonts named, with a pointer to feature 018 so the choice can be traced to Astro's documentation? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the "no new package dependency" requirement consistent with obtaining the font files and subsetting tooling (no dependency added even for tooling)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK015 - Is it stated that no data collection, contact API or secret is touched, so no privacy checklist is needed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK016 - Is the zero-cost requirement stated with its basis (no new service, no extra hosting usage)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]

## Major-Change Governance

- [x] CHK017 - Is the major-change classification (design system and visual identity) stated with its consequence (Don's approval, auto-merge off)? [Completeness, Spec §Background]
- [x] CHK018 - Is the supersession of feature 018's D2 and FR-008 recorded so the two specs do not conflict? [Consistency, Spec §Background]

## Visual Baselines

- [x] CHK019 - Is the set of baselines allowed to change defined as exactly the code-bearing subjects, with a way to list them before regenerating? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the rule that visual shots wait for the code faces, as for Inter, defined for subjects that draw only some faces? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK021 - Are the steps if Docker-generated Linux baselines fail CI defined, including the requirement to tell Don before landing CI-artifact baselines? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the assumption that only the fixture post template draws code validated by a stated confirmation step? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
